title: Quenched Jamaican Buckwheat Stew
description: A moist and earthy Jamaican buckwheat stew thickened with coconut milk, simmered with sweet potato, carrot, and kale, finished with lime for brightness. This sattvic-friendly dish offers comforting flavors in a single pot.
instructions: Rinse 200g buckwheat groats under cold water until the water runs clear.
In a large pot, combine the rinsed buckwheat, 400ml coconut milk, and 600ml vegetable broth; bring to a gentle simmer over medium heat.
Add the diced carrots, sweet potato, and tomatoes to the pot, stirring to coat the vegetables in the liquid.
Sprinkle in 10g ginger, 5g cumin, 5g salt, and 2g pepper, then reduce the heat to low and cover the pot.
Let the stew simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the buckwheat and vegetables are tender.
Fold in 150g chopped kale and simmer for an additional 5 minutes until the greens are wilted.
Remove the pot from heat and stir in 15ml lime juice for a subtle citrus lift.
Taste and adjust seasoning if needed, adding more salt or pepper to suit your preference.
Ladle the stew into bowls, garnish with fresh coriander if desired, and serve hot.
